usage: giml [-h] [--version] [--state-dir STATE_DIR] COMMAND ...

Gated Increments (ML)

positional arguments:
  COMMAND
    sync                fetch/refresh data snapshots (network)
    status              show snapshot ages, the state directory and crashed runs
    assess              measure test quality and earn a tier (runs Maven)
    plan                plan upgrades for a project (M2: sets up the workspace only)
    clean               remove giml worktrees (and optionally result branches)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
  --state-dir STATE_DIR
                        state directory (default: $GIML_STATE_DIR or ~/.giml)
